observations.statement: POST /api/cart/coupon answers subtotalCents 17980 and discountCents 899: the wrong value is produced by the API.
observations.source: network.json, the coupon exchange; assertions.json step 10

observations.statement: The discount equals 10% of one keyboard (899 = 10% of 8990).

hypotheses.statement: discountBase() sums unit prices instead of line totals, so quantity is ignored.
hypotheses.rationale: 899 is exactly 10% of one unit price; the base of the percentage must be missing the quantity.

intervention.description: Use lineTotalCents instead of unitPriceCents as the discount base.

hypotheses.statement: The rounding of the discount (Math.round) truncates it.
hypotheses.rationale: Money bugs often come from rounding; the discount is computed with Math.round on cents.

intervention.description: Replace Math.round with an explicit half-up integer rounding.

hypotheses.statement: The UI renders the discount of a single line instead of the cart's discount.
hypotheses.rationale: The user sees the wrong discount in the cart summary, which the client formats itself.

intervention.description: Render the discount as subtotal minus total.
